doc.title: Will It Rain - Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: The app must provide a responsive, touch-friendly experience optimized for mobile devices. Touch targets must meet WCAG 2.1 AA minimum size requirements (44x44px).

story-context.constraints:
**Architecture Constraints:** - Use Tailwind CSS utilities only - no custom CSS media queries (ADR-006) - Maintain mobile-first responsive approach from Story 4.3 - No new dependencies - use existing Next.js and React touch event handling - Preserve Shadcn UI component compatibility
**Touch Interaction Constraints:** - Minimum 44x44px touch targets (WCAG 2.1 AA requirement) - ALREADY MET by Story 4.3 - No hover-only interactions - all functionality must work via touch - Use native HTML input attributes (inputMode, autoComplete, autoCorrect, autoCapitalize) - Prevent double-tap zoom using CSS touch-action or viewport meta (preserve pinch-zoom)
**Mobile Keyboard Constraints:** - Location input: type="text", inputMode="text" for city/zipcode entry - autoComplete="off" to prevent browser autocomplete interference - autoCorrect="off" for location names (cities are proper nouns) - autoCapitalize="words" for proper location capitalization
**Testing Constraints:** - Must test on real iOS and Android devices (not just DevTools emulation) - Test touch interactions, not mouse events - Verify keyboard types appear correctly on mobile - Test scroll behavior on long content (answer cards with multiple rain windows)
**Performance Constraints:** - No 300ms tap delay (modern browsers handle this automatically, verify with testing) - Immediate visual feedback on touch (button press states, loading indicators) - Smooth scrolling without jank on mobile devices

tests.standards:
**Testing Framework:** Manual testing on real iOS and Android devices (no automated touch testing in this story)
**Browser DevTools:** Use Chrome DevTools Device Mode for preliminary testing, but final validation requires real devices
**Touch Event Testing:** Verify touch events (touchstart, touchend) work correctly, not just click events
**Keyboard Testing:** Test mobile keyboard appearance and input types on iOS Safari and Chrome Mobile (Android)
**Accessibility Testing:** Ensure pinch-zoom still works for users who need magnification
**Cross-Device Testing:** Test on multiple device sizes (iPhone SE, iPhone 14 Pro, iPad, Android phones/tablets)
tests.locations: - Manual testing on real devices (iOS Safari, Chrome Mobile, iPad) - Browser DevTools → Device Mode → Touch emulation (preliminary only) - No automated tests for touch interactions in this story
tests.ideas:
**Test Idea 1: Immediate Touch Response (AC-1)** - Test: Tap search button on iOS Safari → Verify button responds instantly (no 300ms delay) - Test: Tap input field on Android Chrome → Verify keyboard appears immediately - Test: Tap disabled button during loading → Verify no interaction occurs - Expected: All touch interactions respond within 100ms (perceived as instant)
**Test Idea 2: No Hover-Only Interactions (AC-2)** - Test: Navigate app using only touch (no mouse) on iPad - Test: Verify no tooltips or hover states are required for functionality - Test: Check all buttons/inputs work via tap (no hover-then-click required) - Expected: 100% functionality available via touch alone
**Test Idea 3: Touch Target Sizes (AC-3)** - Test: Tap buttons and inputs with fingers (not stylus) on iPhone SE (smallest screen) - Test: Measure rendered button heights in DevTools (should be 48px minimum on mobile) - Test: Verify no accidental taps on adjacent elements - Expected: All interactive elements ≥ 44x44px (Story 4.3 already meets this: 48px-64px range)
**Test Idea 4: Mobile Keyboard Input Types (AC-4)** - Test: Tap location input on iOS Safari → Verify text keyboard appears (not numeric) - Test: Type city name → Verify autocapitalize works ("san francisco" → "San Francisco") - Test: Verify autocorrect is disabled (city names are proper nouns) - Test: Verify autoComplete="off" prevents browser suggestions - Expected: Text keyboard with proper capitalization, no autocorrect/autocomplete
**Test Idea 5: No Double-Tap Zoom (AC-5)** - Test: Double-tap search button on iOS Safari → Verify no zoom occurs - Test: Double-tap input field on Chrome Mobile → Verify no zoom occurs - Test: Pinch-to-zoom gesture → Verify zoom still works (accessibility requirement) - Expected: Double-tap does not zoom, but pinch-zoom works
**Test Idea 6: Natural Swipe and Scroll (AC-6)** - Test: Scroll vertically on answer display with multiple rain windows → Verify smooth scrolling - Test: Overscroll at top/bottom of page → Verify bounce effect works (iOS) - Test: Swipe horizontally → Verify no unintended navigation - Expected: Natural scrolling behavior, no conflicts with gestures
**Test Idea 7: Tactile Feedback for Loading States (AC-7)** - Test: Tap search button → Verify loading spinner appears immediately - Test: Verify button text changes to "Checking..." instantly - Test: Verify input and button become disabled (visual feedback) - Test: Screen reader announces loading state - Expected: Immediate visual feedback on touch, loading state announced
**Test Idea 8: Cross-Device Touch Testing (AC-All)** - Test on iOS Safari (iPhone SE, iPhone 14 Pro, iPad) - Test on Chrome Mobile (Android phone, Android tablet) - Test on Samsung Internet (if available) - Document any device-specific issues (e.g., iOS keyboard quirks) - Expected: Consistent touch behavior across all devices
